responsibility: Top-level orientation document for the imported DMD front-end subtree in GDC. It explains the major subdirectories and groups the flat `dmd` source layout by compiler stage—driver, parsing, semantic analysis, code generation glue, mangling, linking, special outputs, and utilities—so maintainers can map files to front-end responsibilities rather than implementing compiler logic itself.
same_name_distinction: This is the umbrella README for the entire `gcc/d/dmd` subtree: unlike the `common/README.md` and `root/README.md` files, it introduces the overall imported DMD source tree and organizes multiple subdirectories and compiler stages, including `common/` and `root/` themselves.
